entry.title: RV Fire In Dillard Damages Utility Lines, Spreads To Nearby Trees
entry.summary: Central Douglas Fire & Rescue crews responded Sunday to a fully involved camp trailer fire on Cobb Street in Dillard. The fire spread to nearby trees and damaged overhead utility lines. No injuries were reported.

entry.title: Balcony Fire At Winston Apartment Complex Contained Saturday
entry.summary: Central Douglas Fire & Rescue crews responded Saturday to a balcony fire at a Winston apartment complex. Residents used fire extinguishers to help control the fire before crews arrived. No injuries were reported.

entry.title: Roseburg Schools Plans $4.5 Million In Reductions As Enrollment Declines And Costs Rise
entry.summary: Roseburg Schools plans about $4.5 million in budget reductions for 2026-27, including layoffs affecting about 19 employees, as declining enrollment, rising costs and grant reductions place pressure on the district.

entry.title: Diamond Lake Campground Opens For Season, New Scan And Pay Rules In Place

entry.title: Roseburg To See Warm Weekend Before Memorial Day Cooldown
